Overall, it is a well-executed and comprehensive infographic piece.

fields.Medal Notes: This body of work stands out as some of the strongest in sports print, combining smart concepts, exceptional art direction, and consistently high-level execution anchored by striking visuals. It brings a fresh, diverse, and sometimes playful approach to sports coverage, pushing beyond traditional treatments while showcasing both depth of skill and a clear willingness to evolve creatively.
